name: Sunday Harbour View Sukhumvit 50 Hotel
detail: The room is clean and tidy, with complete amenities. The bed is soft, and the pillows and bedding are clean and not old. The parking lot is spacious, the accommodation is quiet, and the staff is lovely with good service. I booked for under a thousand, overall it's very worth the price.

name: Solaria Nishitetsu Hotel Bangkok
detail: I used it when traveling to the Queen Sirikit Convention Center. It is directly connected to BTS Asok / MRT Sukhumvit station. When you get off at the station, there are arrows pointing to the hotel above, which is convenient as you can reach the convention center without getting wet from the rain. The station is also directly connected to Terminal 21, making it easy to find places to eat. The room wasn't large, but it was spacious for a Japanese-style hotel, and it was comfortable with good facilities. The staff are also very friendly. (There are staff members who speak Korean!) I haven't had the chance to use the breakfast, bar, or pool.

name: Palette Hi Hotel Bangkok
detail: Room with a good location Review of a room that is beautiful, clean, and offers great value. There are various types and sizes of rooms to choose from, ranging from standard rooms to executive suites, which are very spacious, perfect for relaxing whether you're here for work, a getaway with a partner, family, or hanging out with friends. It's very convenient for traveling, close to shopping malls, the sky train, fresh markets, and night markets. Importantly, the staff here are friendly, polite, and provide excellent service. Highly recommended! Hi Hotel Bangkok ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐🥰🥰

name: Grande Centre Point Sukhumvit 55 Thong Lo
detail: The rooms are good, and the staff are all friendly and cheerful. The hotel is located in the heart of Thong Lor, and there is a shuttle service between the hotel and the BTS station, which is very convenient. The breakfast is delicious, and there are various facilities, including an onsen, massage services, a swimming pool, a fitness center, and a playroom for children.

name: The Landmark Bangkok
detail: This was a last-minute booking due to a flight delay, but it turned out to be the kindest and most comfortable place among the three accommodations I stayed at during this trip. Although it's an older establishment and not a trendy new hotel or an Instagram-worthy spot, the details of older Bangkok hotels that can’t be seen in newer ones are great, and the service from the staff is very comforting. In fact, it’s not uncommon to encounter expensive places where faucets splash a lot, toilets are too high, or amenities that feel overpriced and barely useful. However, here everything felt just right, not too little and not too much, tailored perfectly for guests. They allowed early check-in two hours before our scheduled time and offered late check-out at 4 PM. Additionally, you can enjoy cocktails and a variety of finger foods for free while watching the night view from the 31st-floor lounge. The swimming pool is 2.6 meters deep... Later, I borrowed some tape for my luggage, and they were more than happy to lend it. Thanks to Clovis at the reception, I was well-fed with a really delicious latte, complete with rich milk foam, and I arrived at the airport with ample time to spare. It's located right in front of Nana Station, making it easy to go anywhere, and I was truly disappointed to have only spent one night there. The breakfast might not have a wide variety, but it is prepared with care rather than just relying on seasonings, and the coffee is absolutely the best. Sipping coffee while gazing at the skyscrapers in the morning made me not want to go home. I recommend this place to those who miss classic hotel service. The lounge view of the city is stunning, so skip the rooftop bar and come here instead!

name: Travelodge Sukhumvit 11
detail: It's a great choice at this price range. The rooms are a bit small but comfortable and clean. It's also close to the BTS station. However, walking in the narrow road in front of the hotel is very inconvenient.

name: Mode Sathorn Hotel
detail: The location is very good, next to Surasak BTS station. The room and bathroom are spacious and decorated modernly. I like the large glass windows in the bedroom and bathroom, offering a great view of the city from the 24th floor. The room is clean, and the staff provides good service. We went up for dinner at Rooftop Bar 37; the atmosphere is nice, and the food is delicious. The staff is very attentive, especially a staff member named Ms. Noy, who pays attention to detail and provides impressive service. Thank you for the beautiful and delicious birthday cake. Thank you to the kitchen staff as well.

name: Rambuttri Village Hotel
detail: I stayed for 7 nights and 8 days at Rambuttri Village Hotel during this trip to Bangkok. The location is really great as it is right next to Khao San Road. At night, the street atmosphere is lively, and just going out for a walk feels like a vacation. However, surprisingly, it was quiet in the early morning, so I had no trouble sleeping well. The hotel was overall clean and well-managed. The staff were friendly, and the check-in and check-out processes were quick. The room wasn't big, but the bedding and bathroom were clean, which I was satisfied with, and especially, the air conditioning was powerful, making it feel like heaven when I came back after wandering around all day. Breakfast was simple but varied slightly each day, so I didn't get bored. The rooftop pool was quiet, and the water was clean, making it nice to go up and relax around midday. The atmosphere during sunset is the best. One downside was that there is no elevator. If you have a lot of baggage, it is essential to request a lower floor at check-in. Still, overall, I was satisfied with the location, price, and cleanliness. It was a perfect accommodation for a trip focused on exploring downtown Bangkok. If I go again, I would be willing to rebook.

name: The Quarter Silom by UHG
detail: This accommodation is very convenient, with well-developed transportation and amenities nearby. The cleanliness of the room is satisfactory, and the overall environment is tidy and comfortable. The staff is warm and professional, making you feel at home. The facilities are complete, meeting various needs, and the overall value for money is extremely high, making it highly recommended.

name: ibis Bangkok Sukhumvit 4
detail: Located near Benja Park, there are restaurants and convenience stores in the alley. Plenty of parking. The room is good according to ibis standards, but there is a bit of a musty smell from the carpet in the hallway. Overall, it's okay.
